works.title: The Oracle
works.description: A novel about a protagonist who discovers and creates an 'Oracle' AI agent system designed to fetch information from newsfeeds, strip advertisements, and create a clean knowledge index to restore web search to its pre-algorithmic-manipulation state (resembling Google circa 2000). The narrative explores legal battles around DMCA violations, access-control circumvention, and confrontations with information-silo monopolies that extract and gatekeep knowledge.
works.quote: I was going to make it the journey of discovery of the guy who discovered the Oracle. It would be somewhat of a mystery, with the protagonist finding clues and ultimately putting together operating code that does the following: it goes to newsfeeds, obtains the information, strips out anything that isn't news

works.title: Series Continuity Distillation Framework
works.description: A new analytical framework designed to condense detailed outlines of previously-published books in a multi-book series into lean, essential continuity briefs that preserve lasting consequences, character changes, and key relationships while stripping away moment-to-moment plot details. Designed as a dedicated tool separate from existing chapter-focused frameworks to extract only the information needed for continuity in subsequent books.
works.quote: I need to do one of two things... 2. Create a dedicated Series Continuity Distillation Framework as a new, separate tool... A dedicated tool will perform its specific function with much greater precision
